build_config_app: build an AppConfig instance from environment variables to configure the HuggingFace datasets server
create_endpoint_config: create an EndpointConfig mapping API endpoints to processing step names by input type
test_appconfig_from_env: test AppConfig.from_env loads all nested configs from environment variables
